name: Mikro MSC Berhad
overview: 今年公司以约 RM30 million 通过发行 51,724,138 股新股收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 全部股权，该交易已于 11 月完成；同时与 Hong Kong Cospower Technology 签订战略合作协议，在马来西亚共同开发电池储能系统 (BESS) 项目。
overview_en: During the year, the company proposed to acquire 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd for approximately RM30 million, satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares, and the acquisition was completed in November; it also entered into a strategic partnership agreement with Hong Kong Cospower Technology to jointly develop Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) projects in Malaysia.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面推进收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 全部股权，并与 Hong Kong Cospower Technology 签订 BESS 项目战略合作协议。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company pursued the acquisition of 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd and entered into a strategic partnership agreement with Hong Kong Cospower Technology for BESS projects.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟议收购项下 51,724,138 股新股于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市，拟议收购于同日视为完成。
actions.text_en: The 51,724,138 new shares under the Proposed Acquisition were listed on 19 November 2026, and the Proposed Acquisition was deemed completed on the same date.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 9 月 21 日批准拟议收购项下 51,724,138 股代价股份的上市及报价。
actions.text_en: On 21 September 2026, Bursa Securities approved the listing of and quotation for 51,724,138 consideration shares to be issued pursuant to the Proposed Acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 9 月 14 日就拟议收购发布补充公告。
actions.text_en: On 14 September 2026, released an additional announcement in relation to the Proposed Acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 9 月 11 日向 Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad 提交与拟议收购相关的上市申请。
actions.text_en: On 11 September 2026, submitted the listing application to Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in relation to the Proposed Acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 9 月 9 日签订有条件股份买卖协议，以 RM30 million 收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 全部股权，代价通过发行 51,724,138 股新股支付，发行价约每股 RM0.58。
actions.text_en: On 9 September 2026, entered into a conditional share sale agreement to acquire 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd for RM30 million, satisfied via the issuance of 51,724,138 new shares at approximately RM0.58 per share.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 6 月 3 日与 Hong Kong Cospower Technology Co., Ltd. 签订战略合作协议，在马来西亚共同识别、开发、争取、洽谈及执行电池储能系统 (BESS) 项目。
actions.text_en: On 3 June 2026, entered into a Strategic Partnership Agreement with Hong Kong Cospower Technology Co., Ltd. for the joint identification, development, pursuit, negotiation and execution of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) projects in Malaysia.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 全部股权，集团将该公司纳入旗下。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd, the group brings the company under its umbrella.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 与 Hong Kong Cospower Technology 建立战略合作，进入马来西亚电池储能系统 (BESS) 项目领域。
model_changes.text_en: Established a strategic partnership with Hong Kong Cospower Technology to enter the Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) project space in Malaysia.
